name: Sensos live tracking for JSSI Parts & Engines
category: AOG support: parts, rotables and technicians
summary: From October 14, JSSI Parts & Engines is adding Sensos smart labels to high-value and AOG-critical shipments of parts, engines and APUs across sales, exchange and lease, at no cost to customers. Sensos, which describes itself as an AI services company, pairs the credit-card-sized cellular label with carrier data to report live location, dwell, shock, tamper and temperature, with route alerts if a shipment stalls or misses its flight.
paragraphs: From October 14, JSSI Parts & Engines is adding Sensos smart labels to high-value and AOG-critical shipments of parts, engines and APUs across sales, exchange and lease, at no cost to customers. Sensos, which describes itself as an AI services company, pairs the credit-card-sized cellular label with carrier data to report live location, dwell, shock, tamper and temperature, with route alerts if a shipment stalls or misses its flight.
whyItMatters: When an aircraft is down, the hangar plans around a carrier estimate that is often wrong. Knowing the moment a part misses its flight lets you re-source or reschedule the crew hours earlier, which is real money on every AOG event.
pricing: Included at no cost on eligible JSSI Parts & Engines shipments
